object.description: Setup: debug build, database viewer, distance unit kilometre. Steps: 1. Record a Run of 2.5 km and finish it. 2. Read the stored splits of the workout. Expected: 3 splits, each with distance, duration and pace; the first 2 cover 1000 m and the third covers about 500 m and is the only split marked partial. SplitAccumulatorTest proves the split calculation only, not the stored rows.
